# UISlash

> An opinionated UI library that is fully integrated with its theming.

UISlash is strict on purpose. It fixes the look and feel, so a site built with it, by people or by agents, looks good every time. It is not an extensible framework with every option.

The components and the themes are designed together. Every theme remaps every palette utility the components use, and the library's tests enforce it for each theme. Switching theme reskins a whole site with no component change, and there is nothing to configure.

The aim is a site built only from UISlash components, configured through props, with no custom CSS or Tailwind.

Every component has one right way to use it. There are no extension recipes and no styling escape hatches: do not restyle a component, compose the parts.

## Install

1. Add the components and a theme. React, React DOM and Tailwind CSS v4 are peers.
```bash
bun add @slashsuite/ui-react @slashsuite/themes
```

2. Import the theme in your CSS, after Tailwind, and point Tailwind at the components' build, since it skips node_modules:
```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@slashsuite/themes/catppuccin-mocha.css";
@source "../node_modules/@slashsuite/ui-react/dist";
```

3. Put the theme's class on <html>. The class for each theme is listed below.

4. Browser support is the web platform as of the Baseline digest of August 2026: current Chrome and Edge (131+), Firefox (143+) and Safari (18.4+, macOS and iOS). Older browsers and polyfills are not supported.

### Themes
Each theme is one CSS file that remaps the components' colours under its own class, and all of them are in one package.
- Catppuccin Latte: `@slashsuite/themes/catppuccin-latte.css`; Class on <html>: `latte`.
- Catppuccin Mocha: `@slashsuite/themes/catppuccin-mocha.css`; Class on <html>: `dark`.
- Slash Suite: `@slashsuite/themes/slash-suite.css`; Class on <html>: `slash-suite`.
- Slash Suite Dark: `@slashsuite/themes/slash-suite-dark.css`; Class on <html>: `slash-suite-dark`.
- Thriftloop: `@slashsuite/themes/thriftloop.css`; Class on <html>: `thriftloop`.
- Thriftloop Dark: `@slashsuite/themes/thriftloop-dark.css`; Class on <html>: `thriftloop-dark`.
- Thrifty Paper: `@slashsuite/themes/thrifty-paper.css`; Class on <html>: `thrifty-paper`.

## Components

Each component page is its own file under `components/`: the one right way, do and don't, accessibility and props. Read the page before you use the component.

### Layout
- AppShell (components/app-shell.md): Every page of an app sits in one `AppShell`; it is the only place the page canvas, the font and the header live.
- SiteFooter (components/site-footer.md): The footer of a marketing site or a docs site, in `AppShell`'s `footer` slot. An app with no footer leaves the slot empty.
- StickyBar (components/sticky-bar.md): A page's filters or bulk actions that must stay in reach while a long `bleed` page scrolls.
- Container (components/container.md): Content outside an `AppShell`, such as a band in a `bleed` shell, that must start at the same x as the page.
- PageHeader (components/page-header.md): The first block of every page but a landing page, which opens with a `Hero`; it puts the page's first content at the same y on every page.
- Hero (components/hero.md): The first block of a site's landing page, and nowhere else: every other page opens with a `PageHeader`.
- Stack (components/stack.md): Any blocks that follow each other: space is a Stack's `gap`, never a margin on a block.
- Cluster (components/cluster.md): Items in a line that are not buttons: a label beside a value, an input beside its actions, a row of pills.
- SideColumn (components/side-column.md): Any main area beside a side panel, such as a thread beside its assistant or a record beside its facts; a whole page with a header is `DetailLayout`, which is this split under a `PageHeader`.
- CardGrid (components/card-grid.md): Several cards or `StatTile`s of the same weight that should sit side by side on a wide screen.
- Show (components/show.md): Content that only fits a wide screen, and its narrow-screen form: a table from `sm`, a stack of cards below it.
- Divider (components/divider.md): One line between a heading and its content, or above a footer.

### Page layouts
- ListLayout (components/list-layout.md): An index of quotes, builds, members or any other collection; a single record is `DetailLayout`.
- DetailLayout (components/detail-layout.md): One quote, build or member, with its content in the main column and its facts in the aside.
- FormLayout (components/form-layout.md): Creating or editing a record on a page of its own.
- ProseLayout (components/prose-layout.md): Privacy, terms, help or any page that is mostly paragraphs.
- SidebarLayout (components/sidebar-layout.md): A section with several sub-pages, such as settings, where the rail is the way between them.
- DocsLayout (components/docs-layout.md): Every page of a docs site: a nav of grouped pages, an article with its own headings, and previous and next in reading order.
- FullBleedLayout (components/full-bleed-layout.md): A viewer that needs the whole width, such as a snapshot, a canvas or a player; an ordinary page is not.
- CenteredLayout (components/centered-layout.md): Sign-in, a landing page, or a not-found or error page.

### Text
- Headings (components/headings.md): Any title on a page: the public headline, the page title, a section, a subsection.
- Prose (components/prose.md): The body of a docs page or an article, where a reader scans headings. An app screen never uses it.
- Body text (components/body-text.md): Every run of text that is not a heading: a paragraph, a supporting line, a note, a label, the line in an empty Card.
- Code (components/code.md): A command, name or path inside a sentence is `Code`; several lines of code are a `CodeBlock`.
- CodeExample (components/code-example.md): Documentation that shows a part and its source together.
- Kbd (components/kbd.md): A key or a shortcut the reader presses: `Esc`, `?`, `⌘S`.
- Markdown (components/markdown.md): Text that arrives as markdown, such as an agent's summary, shown on a page.
- TextLink (components/text-link.md): A link that sits in text. A link that must look like a button is a `Button` with `href`.
- BulletList (components/bullet-list.md): Items that read as a list of points: what changed, what to bring.
- MetaList (components/meta-list.md): The facts about a record under its title (branch, SHA, date), or a footer's row of links (Privacy, Terms, Contact).

### Content
- Card (components/card.md): A titled block of related content: a record, a status, a list, an empty state.
- Avatar (components/avatar.md): Marking who did something or who owns something, next to their name.
- AvatarStack (components/avatar-stack.md): Who is in something (a team, the reviewers, the people on a page) where one row says it.
- Badge (components/badge.md): A count of unread or pending things that sits on an icon button.
- Pill (components/pill.md): A short word that says what state or kind something is: paid, draft, flaky.
- Steps (components/steps.md): The way into a product: install, log in, run.
- Timeline (components/timeline.md): A history of what happened and when: status changes, a record's activity.
- Disclosure (components/disclosure.md): Detail the person may not need on first sight: a history, an FAQ answer, the fine print.
- KeyValueList (components/key-value-list.md): A set of facts about one thing: size, status, dates, shortcut keys.
- Video (components/video.md): Showing a recording or a walkthrough that your app serves.
- Image (components/image.md): Showing a picture that your app serves: a screenshot, a QR code, a product shot.
- MediaTile (components/media-tile.md): A photo or video in a grid or a strip, that opens full size when it is picked: a status, a gallery, an attachment.
- ScrollStrip (components/scroll-strip.md): A row of media or people that is longer than the page is wide: recent statuses, a team.
- ChatThread (components/chat-thread.md): Holding the messages and tool calls of a chat, an agent log or a message thread.
- ChatMessage (components/chat-message.md): A message from a person or an assistant inside a `ChatThread`.
- ChatComposer (components/chat-composer.md): The foot of a chat, under the `ChatThread`.
- OutlineRegion (components/outline-region.md): Marking an area of a screenshot or an image: one that is ignored, flagged or picked.

### Actions
- Button (components/button.md): An action that changes something in place: save, cancel, delete, retry.
- IconButton (components/icon-button.md): An action with a familiar icon and no room for a word: delete, settings, alerts.
- Menu (components/menu.md): A row, card or header with more actions than fit: put the one main action in view and the rest in a Menu.
- Icon (components/icon.md): A glyph beside text or inside a control: a flag in a row, a camera in a Button, or a feature icon (`name` at `feature` size) that stands for an idea.
- CopyButton (components/copy-button.md): A value the page already shows that a reader will paste elsewhere.
- CopyLine (components/copy-line.md): A command or token a reader pastes elsewhere.
- ColourSchemeToggle (components/colour-scheme-toggle.md): A site that offers both schemes: one toggle in the header or controls.

### Forms
- Field (components/field.md): Every text, select or file control: it gets a label, visible unless its purpose is plain from what surrounds it.
- Input (components/input.md): A short piece of text: a name, an amount, a search term.
- Textarea (components/textarea.md): Text that runs to a sentence or a paragraph: a review, a note, a message.
- Select (components/select.md): One choice from a list of about five or more: a category, a country, a rating.
- Checkbox (components/checkbox.md): An on/off option the person ticks: a setting, a filter, a row to select.
- Switch (components/switch.md): A setting that acts the moment it is flipped, usually by saving it to a server: a flag per environment, notifications on or off.
- RadioGroup (components/radio-group.md): A setting or answer with two to five options the person should see side by side: a visibility, a delivery method, a type.
- FileDrop (components/file-drop.md): Uploading a file: a statement, a photo, an import.
- FormRow (components/form-row.md): `FormGrid` lays Fields out in two columns; `FormRow` puts several controls and a save button on one line.
- DateField (components/date-field.md): Any date a person enters; leave `calendar` off for a date the person knows by heart.
- DateRangePicker (components/date-range-picker.md): A from and to date: a report period, a timeline filter.
- SegmentedControl (components/segmented-control.md): A mode or a range chosen in place: daily or weekly, split or even.
- Fieldset (components/fieldset.md): Several controls that answer one question or belong together, under one name.

### Data
- Table (components/table.md): Records that share columns, where a person compares values down a column.
- ListRow (components/list-row.md): A short list where each row opens something, toggles a section or holds its own buttons.
- SortableList (components/sortable-list.md): A list the user puts in order, such as a priority queue: tasks under priority bands, the next one on top.
- StatTile (components/stat-tile.md): A single number a person should see first: a total, a date, a balance.
- ProgressBar (components/progress-bar.md): How far something has got toward a whole: money saved, steps done.
- SplitBar (components/split-bar.md): Two sides of one total: a pot split between two goals, for and against.
- StackedBar (components/stacked-bar.md): The make-up of one whole in three or more parts: results by status, spend by group.
- TrendChart (components/trend-chart.md): A figure over ordered time buckets: weekly counts, a trend.

### Feedback
- Callout (components/callout.md): A message the reader should see in the page, without being made to answer it.
- Toast (components/toast.md): A confirmation or an offer that should not move the page: Saved, Copied, Update available.
- EmptyState (components/empty-state.md): A whole page or list with no content yet: say what belongs here and offer the first step.
- Loading (components/loading.md): Data that is on its way: give the layout or the part `loading` and keep the tree it draws with data.
- Dialog (components/dialog.md): A confirmation or a short form the reader must answer before they go on.
- Drawer (components/drawer.md): A record or a form the reader works on beside the page, with actions that stay in view.
- BottomSheet (components/bottom-sheet.md): A list or details over a full-screen view (a map, a canvas) that must stay usable behind it.
- Lightbox (components/lightbox.md): Showing a photo or a video at full size, and stepping through a set of them.
- FieldDialog (components/field-dialog.md): Asking for a single name or value: new project, rename, a label.
- PageFade (components/page-fade.md): A site where the frame stays put and only the content between pages should fade.
- Morph (components/morph.md): A card or thumbnail that opens into its own page, where the reader should see the one become the other.
- NavigationProgress (components/navigation-progress.md): A page load of unknown length: show at once that the click did something, until the next page renders.

### Navigation
- Tabs (components/tabs.md): Tabs switch a panel on the same page. A row of links to other pages is `Tabs` with link items.
- Breadcrumbs (components/breadcrumbs.md): A page several levels deep that needs a way back up: org, project, build, snapshot.
- Pagination (components/pagination.md): A list split into pages that the reader moves through: a directory, search results, an archive.
- SiteSearch (components/site-search.md): A site with more pages than a reader can scan in its nav: a docs site, an app with many sections.

### Pages
- Status pages (components/status-pages.md): A route that cannot show its content: use the status page that names the state.
